description: Source code for the LP3943 LED driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing LED control functions including on/off, brightness, and blinking, with hardware-specific register manipulations and I2C communication.

methods.name: lp3943_get_led_reg
methods.description: Determines the register associated with a given LED index.

methods.name: lp3943_set_dim_states
methods.description: Sets the dimming state for a specific LED.

methods.name: lp3943_led_blink
methods.description: Configures blinking behavior for an LED with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: lp3943_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level for a specific LED.

methods.name: lp3943_led_init
methods.description: Initializes the LED driver, setting hardware limits and checking device readiness.
